findings.finding: The official HKMA current IC-1 landing page was retained with HTTP 200. It identifies Risk Management Framework, dated 6 October 2017, and links IC-1.pdf (695.8 KB) at the exact official PDF URL fetched in request 007. It also lists related notices, including later dates.
findings.remaining: This verifies the recovered public route and its listed edition. It does not by itself establish transaction-date applicability, completeness of later circulars, or the bank's compliance.

findings.finding: The linked official IC-1 PDF was retained with HTTP 200: 695,824 bytes, SHA-256 7db6f2fa6cd8169c841b503656af308a7cb4f1e4c51f3f810b6cda6fd94447ed. Page 1 identifies Supervisory Policy Manual IC-1 Risk Management Framework, V.3 - 06.10.2017, a statutory guideline under Banking Ordinance section 7(3), applying to all authorized institutions and superseding V.1/V.2. Pages 3-4 give proportional application and local/group scope; pp.18-24 cover policies, limits and new-product assessment/approval (sections 4.1-4.3), including significant product changes. The official current landing page points to this edition as of retrieval.
findings.remaining: Public retrieval of this edition is closed. Date-specific applicability, related circulars, incorporation into the bank-law registry, and actual bank/client facts remain open. Text extraction has not been independently validated page by page; retrieval and these source-text checks do not discharge any bank duty.
